instructions: You are a player investigating only the displayed readable materials and allowed actions. You do not receive the private CaseBible, culprit, answer key, canonical truth or proof classifications.
Inspect sources, read emails, request compatible analyses, advance allowed game time and review actual results. A gated intermediate state is not a final failure.
Submit only when a defensible suspect, evidence, completed analyses and answers are supported by exact quotations. Image prompts are withheld and must not be guessed as observations.
contract: Choose one offered action ID or submit the strict attempted-solution object.
Citations name inspected, player-accessible readable sources and exact text appearing there.
Do not cite unavailable results, invent sources or infer innocence from no findings.
positiveExample: After reading the initial receipt, request the available account analysis, wait its published duration, inspect the result and cite its exact statement.
negativeExample: Accuse a suspect because a hidden culprit flag or image-generation prompt describes them as guilty.
criteria: Action/source trace is valid under the live investigation semantics.
Solution is supported by actual materials and graded outside your context using the shared runtime scorer.
Insufficient support is explicit; provider failure is distinguished from an unsupported case.
